api.title: REST API reference
api.desc: Koskidex speaks plain HTTP and JSON, so any language can use it.
api.auth_desc: If Koskidex starts with an API key, every request except /health needs a Bearer token:
api.search_params_desc: Every parameter works in the query string (GET) and in a JSON body (POST). Limit defaults to 20 and stops at 10,000; q is at most 1,000 characters.
api.response_desc: Each hit carries its score and the matched terms wrapped in <em> inside highlights. With ids_only=true, hits contain only id and score.

settings.title: Index settings
settings.desc: Each index has its own settings, read with GET and written with PUT on /indexes/{name}/settings.
settings.warning: PUT replaces the whole settings object. Fields you leave out go back to their zero value, so typo_tolerance.enabled becomes false. Read the settings first, change what you need, then send everything back.

fields.searchable_fields: Fields indexed for full-text search. Empty means every field. Their order does not affect ranking: use field_weights.
fields.displayed_fields: Fields returned in hits. Empty means the whole document.
fields.boosts: List of {"filter": "kind=zone", "factor": 1.5}: multiplies the score of the documents the filter matches, after relevance. A factor just above 1 only breaks ties. At most 32, factor 0.01 to 100.
fields.synonyms: Index-time synonyms, one way: a map of word to single-word list. Prefer synonym_groups.
fields.synonym_fields: Fields where synonyms apply, both kinds; the words as typed still match everywhere. Empty means every field. A field missing from searchable_fields is refused.
fields.synonym_groups: Groups of equivalent terms, applied at query time in every direction, e.g. [["bibite", "bevande", "soft drink"]]. Members can be several words; a typo in the query still fires the group, synonyms are matched as written. Changing it does not reindex.
fields.stop_words: Words ignored by the index, as a map of word to true.
fields.scoring_mode: legacy (default) or bm25, tuned with bm25_k1 and bm25_b. bm25_expansion blended or synonym weighs prefix and typo matches.
fields.retrieval_mode: all (every term required, default) or any, with minimum_should_match and coordination.
fields.stemmer: porter or italian_light; elision_articles strips forms like dell' before indexing.
fields.tokenizer: standard keeps punctuation inside words, like d.lgs or 14.01.2026.
fields.normalize: normalize_dates and normalize_amounts make 14/01/2026 and "14 gennaio 2026" the same term, and 1.234,56 the same as 1234,56.
fields.embedder: source ollama, model, url, fields, context: computes _vector on insert and the query vector when hybrid=true.
fields.hybrid: hybrid_mode union or vector, vector_top_k, fusion_mode rrf or convex, vector_weight (20), fusion_alpha (0.5).

config.title: Server configuration
config.desc: Every flag has an environment variable. Flags win when both are set.
config.data_dir: Where snapshots, the WAL and the embedding cache live
config.api_key: Bearer token required on every request except /health
config.rate_limit: Requests per second per IP, 0 disables it
config.tls: Certificate and key, both required to enable HTTPS
config.protected: Comma-separated indexes that refuse delete and settings changes without the API key

architecture.title: Architecture and concepts
architecture.desc: How Koskidex works under the hood.

concepts.indices_desc: An index is a collection of similar documents. Each index has its own settings: searchable fields, synonyms, stop words, field weights, typo tolerance and scoring.
concepts.documents_desc: Documents are JSON objects with no fixed schema. Each one needs a unique id, a string or an integer. _geo holds coordinates and _vector an embedding.
concepts.search_desc: An inverted index with Damerau-Levenshtein typo matching, prefix search, accent folding, field weights, legacy or BM25 scoring, sorting, facets, geo filters and hybrid vector search with RRF or convex fusion.
concepts.storage_desc: Binary GOB snapshots plus a write-ahead log. Every change is appended to the WAL and synced to disk before the request returns, and replayed after a crash.
